title: PersistedSession (v2)
description: Extends v1 with tool window state. See ../data-model.md for semantics and the migration rule. A file at v1 is migrated forward by filling defaults, NOT discarded; only a version above the current one is discarded.
x-constraints-not-expressible-in-json-sc: active_destination_id, when non-null, must name a known rail destination; a dangling reference is repaired by falling back to the first available destination, not by discarding the session
width >= MIN_TOOL_WINDOW_WIDTH when not collapsed (clamped on load, rejected on a live command)
width is retained while collapsed so restoring returns the previous size
v1 files are migrated forward with defaults; only schema_version above the current value is discarded
